req.title: Reject negative skip
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the skip parameter is negative.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-006 requires HTTP 422 when skip < 0. The violation was test[3] (test_skip_negative_two_returns_422) having kind=negative but heuristic=EP. The rule is that a negative kind test must not use EP as its heuristic — EP is for equivalence partitioning of valid partitions in positive tests, while negative tests should use NEG. Fix: change test[3] heuristic from EP to NEG, which correctly classifies skip=-2 as a representative of the invalid (negative) input partition tested via a negative technique. All other tests are preserved exactly as they were.

tests.name: test_skip_zero_returns_200_with_all_tasks
expected: Response body is a JSON array of 20 tasks
First task id is 1 with title 'Read chapter 5'
trace: R-TASK-006: skip=0 is the minimum valid value (ge=0), must not be rejected
BVA: tests the exact lower boundary of the valid partition
Catches mutations that change ge=0 to gt=0 or ge=1
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)
r = client.get("/tasks/?skip=0")
assert r.status_code == 200
body = r.json()
assert isinstance(body, list)
assert len(body) == 20
assert body[0]["id"] == 1
assert body[0]["title"] == "Read chapter 5"
assert body[0]["completed"] == True

tests.name: test_skip_boundary_minus_one_vs_zero
expected: The two responses differ in status code exactly at the boundary
trace: R-TASK-006: boundary between invalid (<0) and valid (>=0) partitions
BVA: tests both sides of the ge=0 constraint in a single test
Catches off-by-one mutations (ge=0 -> ge=1 or ge=-1)

from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)
r_invalid = client.get("/tasks/?skip=-1")
assert r_invalid.status_code == 422
r_valid = client.get("/tasks/?skip=0")
assert r_valid.status_code == 200
assert r_invalid.status_code != r_valid.status_code

tests.name: test_skip_negative_two_returns_422
expected: Error detail references the skip parameter
trace: R-TASK-006: any negative skip must be rejected, not just -1
NEG: skip=-2 is tested via negative technique to confirm the invalid partition (skip < 0) is fully rejected
Catches mutations that only special-case skip==-1 instead of skip<0
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)
r = client.get("/tasks/?skip=-2")
assert r.status_code == 422
body = r.json()
assert "detail" in body
found_skip = any(
    "skip" in str(err.get("loc", ""))
    for err in body["detail"]
)
assert found_skip == True
